header: One price per practice, one line per practitioner
subheader: Talbrunn runs the appointment book, the billing and the recall letters for physiotherapy, occupational-therapy and speech-therapy practices.
lead: Every plan holds the same software. What changes between them is how many practitioners work in it and how many addresses the practice runs from. There is no activation fee, no minimum term and no charge per patient — patients never pay Talbrunn anything.
note: All figures are net and attract 20 % Austrian VAT. Billed monthly in arrears by invoice; cancellable to the end of any month.
